images.alt: An image of a yellow digger repairing a dirt road in the countryside. The tet reads: Beware: map maintenance is occurring!

post.text:
WAMS, our outdoor access mapping system, will be undergoing maintenance on Tues evening, 26 Aug. 
All maps, dashboards, and data services will be unavailable during the upgrade. This is a standard upgrade, and we do not expect issues. However, if you find anything not working on Weds, let us know.

source.agency_name: Herenga ā Nuku Aotearoa (Outdoor Access Commission)
source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
